audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol: 'orbiting stars', 'star poke', 'star rotation', 'star uptime', 'his black hole passive shreds armor', 'anything caught in stars'. None of that exists in the current kit.
audit.why: Riot text: P is Cosmic Creator, which banks Stardust to permanently improve his abilities; Q is Breath of Light, a channelled dragon breath at 750; E is Singularity, a black hole that pulls and executes. There are no orbiting stars and the passive does not shred armour.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0..3], early, mid, late, whys and wants around Breath of Light, Stardust, Singularity, Astral Flight and Falling Star.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields asserted Aurelion Sol has no hard CC — whys[3] 'his lack of hard CC', whys[5] 'his CC problem', spikes[2].text 'he lacks any hard CC of his own', mid, late 'no personal defensive CC', wants.you[1].
audit.why: Falling Star 'deals magic damage and stuns enemies', and Singularity pulls enemies toward its centre. He has both a stun and a displacement.
audit.corrected: Replaced the false premise with the true one: his Q and W are both CHANNELS, so Annie's point-and-click stun cancels them outright — that, not an absence of CC, is why she wins the mid-game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity's execute was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Riot text: 'The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain p[ercent]'. Against a champion with no dash this is a real death sentence when low.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding and dontsFull[2].d now say to track the threshold number rather than the health bar and never sit in the centre when low.
sources: brief.enemyKit E text and percentHealth flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level-chart rows disagreed between layers. full read Annie/Annie/Annie/Skill/Annie/Aurelion Sol/Aurelion Sol; content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie.
audit.why: content and the packet agree with each other and with a 50.81% win rate at 309 games — an even early lane that Annie takes over once the stun can cancel his channels.
audit.corrected: Flipped full phases[0..3].side and phases[5..6].side to match, as one group, with ratings 5/5/5/6/6/6/6 and whys rewritten to the same story.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose named no ability and framed the lane as a pure range war.
audit.why: The real shape: 750 Breath of Light against 625 Q, a 22s Astral Flight as his only exit, and two channels that a point-and-click stun cancels.
audit.corrected: Restated in tldr, enemyWin, breakdown.early, breakdown.carry and report[5].t.

audit.why: Astral Flight is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s, Singularity 12s for 90 mana, Falling Star 120/110/100s, Breath of Light 3s for 35 mana at rank 1.
audit.corrected: All four numbers now on the page, with the sequencing rule 'commit while Astral Flight is down'.

notes: This matchup was written against the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol and had never been updated. Seven fields referenced 'orbiting stars', 'star rotation', 'star uptime' and a 'black hole passive [that] shreds armor' — none of which exist. The current kit is Cosmic Creator (Stardust), Breath of Light (channelled, 750), Astral Flight (channelled flight, 22s at rank 1), Singularity (12s black hole that PULLS and EXECUTES at its centre) and Falling Star, which upgrades to The Skies Descend. Second whole-matchup error: six fields said he has no hard CC. Falling Star stuns and Singularity pulls; the real reason Annie takes over at 4 is that his Q and W are both channels her point-and-click stun cancels. Level chart disagreed on six of seven rows — full said Annie early and Aurelion Sol late, content and packet said the opposite shape; content/packet agree with each other and with a 50.81% win rate, so I flipped full to match, as one group. The Singularity execute is now on the page for the first time. breakdown.wave and dontsFull[1].d remain templated. Flagging for the user: this champion may need a full sweep beyond my slice — if the Aurelion Sol text was stale here it is likely stale in the other five slices too.
